    Frame a gt table with ornaments

    gt_ornament_frame.Rd

    Puts an ornament above the table (in the header, over the title) and another below it (as a source note). Ornaments are inlined as SVG and scale to the width of the table. Because they are HTML, they show in HTML output (Quarto, R Markdown, the Viewer), not in PDF or Word.

    gt_ornament_frame(
  data,
  top = "swelled_rule",
  bottom = "fleuron_rule",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  width = 6,
  height = 0.6,
  ink = "#C9A227",
  seed = 1
)

    Arguments

    data

    A gt_tbl.

    top, bottom

    Ornament id from dk_ornaments(), or a grob, or NULL for none.

    title, subtitle

    Optional title and subtitle text, shown under the top ornament.

    width, height

    Ornament box in inches; the ratio sets its shape, and it scales to the table's width.

    ink

    Colour for ornaments given by id.

    seed

    Integer seed; the bottom ornament uses seed + 1.

    Value

    The modified gt_tbl.

    Details

    Sets the table header, so any existing title or subtitle is replaced; pass title and subtitle here to keep them.

    Examples

    if (requireNamespace("gt", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 1:4])) |>
    gt_ornament_frame(top = "swash", bottom = "fleuron_rule",
                      title = "Motor Trend cars")
}
